Your impact

At Jacobs, we’re challenging today to reinvent tomorrow. Our Grid Transition Advisory (GTA) within the overall Power team is dedicated to navigating the complexities of modern energy evolution. We are seeking a highly collaborative and technically exceptional individual to lead cross-functional delivery across our evolving portfolio of offerings.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional power systems engineering and advanced energy economics to provide holistic support to clients from a reliability and market perspective. Following Jacobs’ acquisition of PA Consulting, you will serve as a vital go-between and strategic liaison to integrate PA Consulting’s premier offerings in market analytics, strategy, and production cost modeling (PCM) with Jacobs Power System Studies team’s core technical capabilities in power systems planning.

Along with executing high-level studies and advisory engagements, you will help spearhead internal technical project management of various specialized offerings, ensuring seamless execution across special studies, utility transmission planning, data center studies, and developer interconnection studies. Furthermore, you will leverage your understanding of RTO/ISO tariffs, markets, developer constraints, and utility operations to deliver high-impact advisory solutions that shape the future grid.
